name: Jealousy
source:
Jealousy takes place 2 months after the Harem Ending of The Engagement. The MC starts his own business with Emily and Suzie. They are now the rival of Rhys Park and Woody George. Yue-Yue also lives with them. She's a college freshman and is working at Corsica, the ice-cream parlor of Dianne. They don’t tell her the fact that Suzie's in a complicated relationship with the MC and Emily. That makes her suspect that her big sister is being molested by the MC. She always tell her boyfriend that she hates the MC. Furthermore, Emily starts to feel grief. She thinks that was a mistake to accept that kind of relationship.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/captainkitty]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
嫉妒发生在订婚后宫结束两个月后。MC与Emily和Suzie一起开始了自己的事业。他们现在是里斯·帕克和伍迪·乔治的竞争对手。悦悦也和他们住在一起。她是一名大学新生，在科西嘉岛黛安的冰淇淋店工作。他们没有告诉她苏西与主持人和艾米丽的关系很复杂。这让她怀疑她的姐姐被主持人猥亵了。她总是告诉她的男朋友，她讨厌MC。此外，艾米丽开始感到悲伤。她认为接受这种关系是错误的。
